title: 提交之后
intent: 捕捉重要项目完成后迟几秒才涌上的开心：紧绷慢慢退去，脚步变轻，最后留下踏实而安静的满足感。

tempo.feel: 4/4中速律动，鼓点略微后靠，踩镲轻巧摇摆

tonality.mode: 大调；开头暂以B小调和弦保留一点未落定的感觉

instrumentation.name: 电钢琴
instrumentation.role: 以简短上行旋律和宽松的延伸和弦承载主线

instrumentation.name: 干净音色的电吉他
instrumentation.role: 在主旋律的空隙作短句回应

instrumentation.name: 合成器贝斯
instrumentation.role: 用简洁而有弹性的音型支撑步伐感

instrumentation.name: 鼓机
instrumentation.role: 以克制的底鼓、军鼓和细碎踩镲维持律动
instrumentation.timbre: 干净、轻脆，避免猛烈重击

structure.direction: 电钢琴从略带悬念的和弦中弹出短小动机；鼓与贝斯稍后轻轻进入，像等待提交后的确认。
主旋律成为完整的上行乐句，吉他在句尾回应；稳定的轻摆鼓点让喜悦开始流动。
贝斯略显活泼，旋律作小幅变化；增加节奏活力，但不提高整体音量。
鼓点暂时变疏，电钢琴舒展和声，留出紧绷感消散的空间。
完整律动和主旋律回归，以更明确的D大调落点表达踏实的成就感。
鼓与贝斯逐层退出，电钢琴和吉他留下简短回应，让最后的和弦自然延续。

production: 干净的录音室质感；电钢琴与吉他清晰自然，鼓组柔和而有弹性。声部彼此分明，瞬态平滑、峰值受控，保留轻重变化而不靠持续增大音量推进。
avoid: 削波、噼啪杂音或非预期的数字失真
assumptions: 以轻盈器乐嘻哈实现未指定的风格。
采用应用设置的约180秒时长，而非正文中的两分钟默认值。
lyriaPrompt: Create an original three-minute instrumental hip-hop piece about the quiet joy of finishing an important project. Instrumental only, no vocals. At 92 BPM in 4/4, use a lightly swung, laid-back drum-machine groove with soft kick, restrained snare and crisp hi-hats. Warm electric piano carries a short rising melody; clean, lightly picked electric guitar answers between phrases, while a rounded synth bass adds a gentle bounce. In D major, begin briefly on B minor to suggest the few seconds before the achievement sinks in, then let spacious major-seventh and add-nine chords bring relief. [Intro] Sparse piano motif; bass and drums enter softly. [Theme] The rising melody takes shape over the easy head-nod groove. [Variation] Give the bass and melody a little more movement without getting louder. [Bridge] Thin the drums and open the harmony, letting tension fall away. [Return] Restore the full groove and resolve the melody warmly in D major. [Outro] Remove layers gradually and let a final piano-and-guitar exchange linger. Keep the celebration light, clear and satisfied, never boisterous. Clean studio recording, natural acoustic timbres where applicable, clear electric-instrument tones, smooth transients and controlled peaks. No clipping, crackling or digital distortion; no vocal samples, harsh crashes or oversized build.
